# Frequently asked questions

This fictional FAQ applies only to the assessment training institute.

## How can I find a suitable course?

State the course category and maximum budget to search the current catalogue. A weekday or weekend preference is optional. A search may return no matching courses; this does not justify changing the customer's budget or schedule without asking.

## How can I arrange a counsellor callback?

A callback enquiry needs the customer's name, a valid phone number, and either a chosen course or stated learning interest. Budget and schedule preferences are optional for an enquiry. A callback request must follow an actual saved lead and the customer's request to be called. This describes the intended workflow; a document does not prove that a lead or callback has been saved.

## Is an enquiry an enrolment?

No. An enquiry, saved lead or callback request is not payment, enrolment or a seat reservation. Check current course availability with the course tools. This assessment has no payment or enrolment integration.

## Do you guarantee jobs, certificates or placement?

No such guarantee or certificate terms are established in this knowledge base. Say that the requested information is unavailable rather than invent a promise.

# Course eligibility

This fictional policy applies only to the assessment training institute.

## Python Basics

Python Basics (PY101) has no programming prerequisites. A learner with no previous programming experience may enquire about this introductory course.

## Advanced Python

Advanced Python (PY202) requires basic programming knowledge. Someone with no programming experience should first consider an introductory course rather than assume they meet this prerequisite.

## Other eligibility questions

This document does not establish age limits, degree requirements, entrance examinations or prerequisites for the data-science courses. If a requested eligibility condition is not documented, say the information is unavailable and offer to collect an enquiry when the lead workflow is available. Current course availability still comes from course tools.

# Refund policy

This fictional refund policy applies only to the assessment training institute.

## Required conditions

A refund is permitted only when BOTH conditions are satisfied: the refund request is made within seven days of payment, AND the learner has not attended the first class. Both conditions must be checked together; satisfying only one is insufficient.

A request after seven days does not qualify under this policy, even if the learner has not attended a class. Attendance at the first class makes the request ineligible under this policy, even if it is within seven days of payment.

## Scope

This prototype does not process payments or refunds. It can explain this documented policy, but cannot confirm that money was refunded. Processing timelines, transaction charges and exceptions are not specified; do not invent them.

# Fitness studio policy

This is a fictional fitness studio created only to demonstrate a second configurable business.

## Trial visits

One introductory trial visit is available per person, subject to confirming a suitable time with studio staff. A customer should bring clean indoor training shoes and a water bottle. This prototype does not book a trial visit or verify whether a person has already used one.

## Membership information

Use getMembershipDetails for current fictional membership names, fees and durations. Do not use the training institute's courses, refund rules or eligibility policy to answer fitness questions.

## Limits

Opening hours, trainer qualifications, cancellation/refund terms and medical advice are not established here. If asked, say the information is unavailable. This assessment does not create fitness leads, callbacks, payments or enrolments.
